_meta.what: THE GOLD BEHAVIOURAL LAYER — each of the 357 canonical medicine acts (lib/pour/medicineActs.js) with its action family. Downstream layers may contextualize an act; they may not change its family. Verbalization (SAY / WRITE / ASK) is the operation only where the canonical act is itself verbal.
